note: Montenegro: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days in any 180, Belarus, Peru, Russia, Saudi Arabia and Türkiye for 30 (one of the listed exemptions ends on 1 November 2026, its country not identifiable in the source read). Everyone else needs a visa (holders of Schengen, UK or US visas or residence may enter visa-free: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.
